hero.title: The full-stack React starter that's ready on day one
hero.description: Authentication, theming, type-safe data, and internationalization are already wired up on TanStack Start — so you can skip the boilerplate and ship your product faster.

react.title: React 19 + Compiler
react.description: React 19 with the React Compiler for automatic memoization — fast UIs without manual tuning.

tanstack.title: TanStack suite
tanstack.description: Start, Router, Query, Form, and Table deliver type-safe routing, data, and forms end to end.

auth.title: Authentication built in
auth.description: Better Auth handles sessions, usernames, and protected routes securely.

database.title: Type-safe database
database.description: Drizzle ORM with Neon Postgres gives you type-safe, serverless data access.

i18n.title: Internationalized
i18n.description: Paraglide compiles type-safe messages, pre-configured for English and Japanese.

dawnUi.title: Dawn UI included
dawnUi.description: Provides accessible, themeable components with light and dark modes.

toolchain.title: Vite+ toolchain
toolchain.description: Vite+ unifies dev, build, test, lint, and format behind a single CLI.

storybook.title: Storybook ready
storybook.description: Develop and document components in isolation with Storybook, plus ready-made example stories.

cicd.title: CI/CD included
cicd.description: A GitHub Actions test workflow and Vite+ Git hooks run checks before every commit, push, and pull request.

cta.title: Start building today
cta.description: Clone the starter and get a production-ready foundation in minutes — authentication, database, and UI included.

layout.title: Everything you need to ship your next product.
layout.description: Authentication, theming, and internationalization come preconfigured so you can focus on the features that matter.

highlights.authDescription: Sessions, usernames, and protected routes wired up.
highlights.themeDescription: Light and dark themes with system sync built in.
highlights.i18nDescription: Type-safe, compiled messages for every locale.
highlights.toolingDescription: TanStack Start on the Vite+ toolchain.
